retired.title: This import is no longer available
retired.description: The stock levels import has been retired: it set stock quantities directly, with no stock movement and no justifying document behind them. Import your opening stock with the Products import instead — it accepts a quantity, a purchase price and a location, and records a proper opening stock movement.
